commands:
Specify a subcommand. Known subcommands are:
    kickmix circuit                       # generate a circuit
    kickmix diagram                       # make a picture of a circuit
    kickmix count_operations              # count instructions in a circuit
    kickmix count_operations_sampled      # count instructions executed while simulating a circuit
    kickmix kmb2kmx                       # reads a kmb file and writes out an equivalent kmx file
    kickmix kmx2kmb                       # reads a kmx file and writes out an equivalent kmb file
    kickmix sample                        # simulate a circuit
    kickmix spin                          # time how long it takes to simulate a circuit
